label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (100% of mass), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded: prev_reward==0 / in_rew 0 at the preceding D1 holds 99% of mass, and it essentially never fires after a reward. It also depends strongly on how far into the episode the trial is. Rate is highest in trials 1-9 (about 15%), falls steadily, and is zero after about trial 70, so (GO & prev_reward==0 & ep_trial<50) reaches dev F1 0.58 with mass recall 0.97 but precision only 0.43. It is also concentrated where the model value output is in a mid-high band (7.5-8.1); a value threshold does not beat the ep_trial cut. Within that set there is weaker enrichment for switch trials and for choosing the bad option (stay=0, chose_good=0, about 2x), which I could not turn into a clean predicate. It never fires at D1 or D2 or after rewarded trials. All variables used are observed (the previous reward; episode time is implicitly available to the recurrent state). A large share of steps matching the predicate stay inactive, so the description is incomplete. The unit likely tracks a slowly decaying early-episode, low-reward-history signal that is gated in at GO.
